title: desmodium axillare
intro: Desmodium axillare, commonly known as "Fleabane", is a plant species belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The health benefits of Desmodium axillare include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
